structure_review.rationale: Figure 1 and Scheme 2 put both methoxyphenyl groups on the same central alkene carbon. PPDC retains the extra para-phenylene bridge and the methyl-substituted dicyanovinyl acceptor. The precursor drawing and the p2-p3 methoxy/methyl proton counts support these groups.
structure_review.limitations: Assistant visual source review and graph checks, not independent expert certification. SI corroboration remains incomplete.

notes: The graph has been corrected against Figure 1 and Scheme 2 in this draft; independent structure review remains required before release.
Retrieve SI geometry, spectra and synthesis; references 35/37 contain prior TPDC/TPPDC syntheses.
Have experts adjudicate whether any additional mechanism is supported beyond CT and triplet sensitization, without forcing a preset number of labels.
Retain probe-based assay limitations and the similar-spin-orbit-coupling assumption.

The p3 mass entry labels 558.2 as [M+1]+, whereas the drawing-derived C39H30N2O2 neutral exact mass is about 558.231. This apparent ion-label inconsistency is not treated as independent formula confirmation.
The original and corrected graphs have identical formulas; mass alone cannot distinguish the connectivity error.
